prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-impact e-commerce infographic for "Apple Pods Pro 3" premium wireless over-ear headphones. Foreground product hero shot: extreme close-up of a hand holding a sleek matte-white premium over-ear headphone toward the camera at a slight angle. The headphone features glossy white ear cushions with soft memory foam padding, a brushed aluminum silver headband with subtle Apple Pods Pro 3 embossed branding, a black mesh speaker grille visible on the ear cup face, a tiny glowing green LED status indicator on the right ear cup edge, and subtle touch-control icons etched on the outer cup surface. Use macro-lens shallow depth of field; hand and headphone are slightly blurred at edges to create cinematic depth, while the product remains razor-sharp in center frame. Central subject: in the mid-ground, a smiling adult woman with freckles and wavy pastel-pink hair wears a vibrant lime-green knit beanie, a psychedelic black and white-striped long-sleeve shirt, and the white over-ear headphones resting around her neck, with one hand casually touching the ear cup. Her expression is relaxed, confident and joyful, glancing slightly off-camera with a natural smile. Background: clean soft-focus studio backdrop, light gray gradient fading to warm white at center, with diagonal rainbow prism lens flares, soft pastel pink and yellow light leaks, 4–5 blurred white over-ear headphones floating at varied depths and rotations, and subtle bokeh circles. Use soft professional three-point studio lighting with key light upper-left, fill light on the right and rim light behind the model. Typography is clean white sans-serif: massive semi-transparent HEADPHONES behind the subject, Apple Pods Pro 3 and Over-Ear Wireless at top right, Premium Sound and Active Noise Cancellation + Transparency Mode at mid-left, 40 hours of battery life at mid-right, 0 to 100% and Fast charge — 10 min = 3hrs playback at lower-left, 1 Year Warranty Included at bottom-right, and Bluetooth 5.4 | Hi-Res Audio Certified | Foldable Design | USB-C Charging at bottom center. Resolution 8K ultra-sharp. Style: commercial product photography meets editorial fashion advertising. Color palette: white, lime green, pastel pink and rainbow prism accents. Focus is tack-sharp on the headphone product with shallow depth of field elsewhere. Lens: 85mm macro, slight low angle. Render quality: hyperrealistic, clean ad aesthetic, vibrant yet professional color grading.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, warped product geometry, unreadable infographic text, incorrect icons, duplicated headphones, distorted hands
